description: A white Apple product box sits on a countertop, and a yellow-and-black tape measure is being used above it. The right hand pulls the tape measure out and lays it diagonally across the box while the left hand steadies the far end, then the right hand retracts and repositions the tape along the box’s long edge and down the side corner, with the left hand pinning the tape and box in place; the tape measure alternates between a right-hand object and a two-hand object as both hands hold it during alignment.
